# Narrow fix: kept original core/chase/occlusion/pause logic; added (1) low-motion pin
# for occluded piles (tight+head-close+close-centroid+strong i_vis drop+r facing/i away)
# to catch still bite/pins (287s,324s) without allowing broad low-motion attack;
# (2) fast-closing fully-visible veto (approach<<0 + i_vis high) to reject
# investigation/run-in false positives (42-44s,197s) while leaving true tussle/chase.
def detect(t, fps):
    _keys = list(t.keys())
    n = len(t[_keys[0]])
    def _get(names):
        for k in names:
            if k in t:
                return np.asarray(t[k], dtype=float)
        return np.full(n, np.nan)
    r_present = _get(['r_present', 'present'])
    r_area = _get(['r_area', 'area'])
    i_area = _get(['i_area'])
    r_speed = _get(['r_speed'])
    i_speed = _get(['i_speed'])
    dist_raw = _get(['dist'])
    gap_raw = _get(['gap'])
    r_h_raw = _get(['r_head_to_i', 'r_head_to_body', 'r_head_to_i_body', 'head_to_body'])
    r_face_raw = _get(['r_facing', 'r_face'])
    i_face_raw = _get(['i_facing', 'i_face'])
    r_vis = _get(['r_visible_ratio'])
    i_vis = _get(['i_visible_ratio'])
    app_raw = _get(['approach', 'approach_speed', 'd_dist', 'ddist', 'dist_change'])
    r_med = np.nanmedian(np.sqrt(r_area))
    i_med = np.nanmedian(np.sqrt(i_area))
    if np.isnan(r_med) and np.isnan(i_med):
        L = 125.0
    elif np.isnan(r_med):
        L = float(i_med)
    elif np.isnan(i_med):
        L = float(r_med)
    else:
        L = float((r_med + i_med) / 2.0)
    r_sp_sm = smooth(r_speed, 3)
    i_sp_sm = smooth(i_speed, 3)
    mov = np.fmax(r_speed, i_speed)
    mov_sm = smooth(mov, 3)
    dist_sm = smooth(dist_raw, 3)
    gap_sm = smooth(gap_raw, 3)
    rh_sm = smooth(r_h_raw, 3)
    r_face_sm = smooth(r_face_raw, 3)
    i_face_sm = smooth(i_face_raw, 3)
    i_vis_sm = smooth(i_vis, 3)
    app_sm = smooth(app_raw, 3)
    contact = gap_sm < (0.25 * L)
    tight = gap_sm < (0.08 * L)
    head_close = rh_sm < (0.5 * L)
    close_cent = dist_sm < (1.2 * L)
    motion_high = mov_sm > (1.2 * L)
    motion_vhigh = mov_sm > (2.0 * L)
    core_bite = contact & head_close & motion_high
    core_tussle = tight & motion_vhigh
    core_pile = contact & close_cent & motion_vhigh
    core = core_bite | core_tussle | core_pile
    core = core & np.isfinite(mov_sm)
    k_recent = int(round(float(fps) * 2.0))
    if k_recent < 3:
        k_recent = 3
    recent_core = smooth(core.astype(float), k_recent) > 0.02
    recent_contact = smooth(contact.astype(float), k_recent) > 0.02
    chase_dist = dist_sm < (2.5 * L)
    chase_motion = mov_sm > (1.5 * L)
    r_faces = r_face_sm < 1.0
    chase = chase_dist & chase_motion & r_faces
    chase_keep = chase & recent_core
    occluded_flag = (i_vis < 0.65) | (~np.isfinite(dist_raw)) | (~np.isfinite(gap_raw))
    occluded_attack = occluded_flag & motion_high & recent_contact
    r_slow = r_sp_sm < (0.7 * L)
    i_slow = i_sp_sm < (0.7 * L)
    both_slow = r_slow & i_slow
    both_face = (r_face_sm < 0.9) & (i_face_sm < 0.9)
    pause_dist = dist_sm < (2.0 * L)
    pause = both_slow & both_face & (~tight) & pause_dist
    # narrow low-motion pin: still pile with intruder occluded under resident
    strong_occl = (i_vis_sm < 0.70) & np.isfinite(i_vis_sm)
    pin = (tight & head_close & close_cent & strong_occl & (r_face_sm < 0.8) & (i_face_sm > 1.0))
    pin = pin & np.isfinite(gap_sm) & np.isfinite(rh_sm) & np.isfinite(dist_sm)
    # narrow investigation veto: fast closing while intruder fully visible
    veto = (app_sm < (-0.8 * L)) & (i_vis_sm > 0.90) & contact
    veto = veto & np.isfinite(app_sm) & np.isfinite(i_vis_sm)
    raw = (core | chase_keep | occluded_attack | pin) & (~pause) & (~veto)
    bridged = bouts_clean(raw, fps, min_s=0.3, max_gap_s=1.0)
    final = bridged & (~pause) & (~veto)
    if np.all(np.isnan(r_present)):
        r_ok = np.isfinite(r_speed)
    else:
        r_ok = (r_present == 1)
    r_ok = r_ok & np.isfinite(r_speed + 0.0)
    final = final & r_ok
    return np.asarray(final, dtype=bool)

# Narrow fix to keep overall rate stable: kept base gap/head/dist/face/vis/active/bouts
# as original; added (1) relative-direction gate r_facing<=i_facing+0.35 to reject
# intruder-led contacts (FP 243s/108s) with little rate cost; (2) rare fast-closing
# chase branch (approach<=-0.3*body) allowing gap<=0.6*body, head<=1.3*body,
# face<=1.8 to catch tail/chase sniffs (miss 4.4s/49s) without broad relaxation;
# (3) fast veto 2.5*body bypassed to 4.0*body only when closing or rear
# (i_facing>=2.0) to keep fast/rear sniffs (miss 49s/140s) but still veto other bursts.
def detect(t, fps):
    N = len(next(iter(t.values())))
    r_area = np.asarray(t.get('r_area', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    med = np.nanmedian(r_area)
    if np.isfinite(med) and med > 0:
        body = float(np.sqrt(med))
    else:
        body = 125.0
    if not np.isfinite(body):
        body = 125.0
    body = float(min(max(body, 80.0), 180.0))

    r_present = np.asarray(t.get('r_present', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    i_present = np.asarray(t.get('i_present', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    gap = np.asarray(t.get('gap', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    dist = np.asarray(t.get('dist', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_facing = np.asarray(t.get('r_facing', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    i_facing = np.asarray(t.get('i_facing', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_speed = np.asarray(t.get('r_speed', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_hx = np.asarray(t.get('r_head_x', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_hy = np.asarray(t.get('r_head_y', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_vis = np.asarray(t.get('r_visible_ratio', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    i_vis = np.asarray(t.get('i_visible_ratio', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    _h = t.get('r_head_to_i', None)
    if _h is None:
        _h = t.get('r_head_to_body', None)
    if _h is None:
        _h = np.full(N, np.nan)
    rhti = np.asarray(_h, dtype=float)
    _a = t.get('approach', None)
    if _a is None:
        approach = np.full(N, np.nan)
    else:
        approach = np.asarray(_a, dtype=float)

    k = max(3, int(round(float(fps) * 0.3)))
    gap_s = smooth(gap, k)
    rhti_s = smooth(rhti, k)
    dist_s = smooth(dist, k)
    fac_s = smooth(r_facing, k)
    ifac_s = smooth(i_facing, k)
    rspd_s = smooth(r_speed, k)
    appr_s = smooth(approach, k)

    hx_s = smooth(r_hx, k)
    hy_s = smooth(r_hy, k)
    dx = np.full(N, np.nan)
    dy = np.full(N, np.nan)
    dx[1:] = hx_s[1:] - hx_s[:-1]
    dy[1:] = hy_s[1:] - hy_s[:-1]
    head_spd = np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * float(fps)
    head_spd_s = smooth(head_spd, k)

    gap_thr = 0.30 * body
    head_on = 0.40 * body
    head_off = 0.60 * body
    dist_thr = 2.5 * body
    face_thr = 0.9
    face_relax = 1.3
    nose_touch = 0.20 * body
    low_r = 0.15 * body
    low_h = 0.40 * body
    high_base = 2.5 * body
    high_chase = 4.0 * body

    gap_chase = 0.60 * body
    head_chase = 1.30 * body
    face_loose = 1.8
    close_thr = -0.30 * body
    rel_margin = 0.35

    present_ok = (r_present == 1) & (i_present == 1)
    gap_ok = np.isfinite(gap_s) & (gap_s <= gap_thr)
    head_hyst = hysteresis(-rhti_s, -head_on, -head_off)
    head_hyst = np.asarray(head_hyst, dtype=bool)
    dist_ok = np.isfinite(dist_s) & (dist_s <= dist_thr)
    vis_ok = np.isfinite(r_vis) & np.isfinite(i_vis) & (r_vis >= 0.70) & (i_vis >= 0.60)

    closing = np.isfinite(appr_s) & (appr_s <= close_thr)
    rear = np.isfinite(ifac_s) & (ifac_s >= 2.0)
    face_base = np.isfinite(fac_s) & ((fac_s <= face_thr) | ((np.isfinite(rhti_s) & (rhti_s <= nose_touch)) & (fac_s <= face_relax)))
    face_extra = np.isfinite(fac_s) & closing & (fac_s <= face_loose)
    face_ok = face_base | face_extra

    has_iface = np.isfinite(ifac_s)
    rel_ok = np.ones(N, dtype=bool)
    rel_ok[has_iface] = np.isfinite(fac_s[has_iface]) & (fac_s[has_iface] <= ifac_s[has_iface] + rel_margin)

    base = present_ok & gap_ok & head_hyst & face_ok & dist_ok & vis_ok & rel_ok

    gap_c_ok = np.isfinite(gap_s) & (gap_s <= gap_chase)
    head_c_ok = np.isfinite(rhti_s) & (rhti_s <= head_chase)
    face_c_ok = np.isfinite(fac_s) & (fac_s <= face_loose)
    chase = present_ok & gap_c_ok & head_c_ok & face_c_ok & dist_ok & vis_ok & rel_ok & closing

    posture = base | chase

    active_inst = (np.isfinite(rspd_s) & (rspd_s >= low_r)) | (np.isfinite(head_spd_s) & (head_spd_s >= low_h))
    bad_head = np.isfinite(head_spd_s) & (head_spd_s > 5.0 * body)
    active_inst = active_inst & (~bad_head)
    w = max(3, int(round(float(fps) * 1.0)))
    act_frac = smooth(active_inst.astype(float), w)
    act_ok = np.isfinite(act_frac) & (act_frac >= 0.15)
    bypass = closing | rear
    veto_fast = (np.isfinite(rspd_s) & (rspd_s > high_base) & (~bypass)) | (np.isfinite(rspd_s) & (rspd_s > high_chase))

    raw = posture & act_ok & (~veto_fast)
    raw = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool)
    out = bouts_clean(raw, fps, min_s=0.3, max_gap_s=0.5)
    return np.asarray(out, dtype=bool)

def detect(t, fps):
    n = -1
    for v in list(t.values()):
        av0 = np.asarray(v)
        if av0.ndim >= 1:
            n = av0.shape[0]
            break
    if n is None or n == -1:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)
    n = int(n)
    if n <= 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)

    def _get(*cands):
        for nm in cands:
            if nm in t:
                av = np.asarray(t[nm], dtype=float)
                if av.ndim == 0:
                    continue
                if av.ndim != 1:
                    av = np.asarray(av.ravel(), dtype=float)
                if av.shape[0] != n:
                    continue
                return av
        return np.full(n, np.nan)

    r_area = _get('r_area')
    i_area = _get('i_area')
    r_cx = _get('r_cx', 'r_x')
    i_cx = _get('i_cx', 'i_x')
    dist = _get('dist')
    gap = _get('gap')
    r_vis = _get('r_visible_ratio', 'r_visible', 'r_vis')
    i_vis = _get('i_visible_ratio', 'i_visible', 'i_vis')
    r_face = _get('r_facing', 'r_face')
    i_face = _get('i_facing', 'i_face')
    r_h = _get('r_heading')
    i_h = _get('i_heading')
    r_speed = _get('r_speed')
    i_speed = _get('i_speed')
    r_ht = _get('r_head_to_i', 'r_head_to_body', 'r_head_to', 'r_head_to_intruder', 'r_htob')
    i_ht = _get('i_head_to_r', 'i_head_to_body', 'i_head_to', 'i_head_to_resident', 'i_htob')
    r_elo = _get('r_elong', 'r_elongation', 'r_aspect')
    i_elo = _get('i_elong', 'i_elongation', 'i_aspect')
    r_present = _get('r_present', 'r_exist')
    i_present = _get('i_present', 'i_exist')

    r_sqrt = np.sqrt(np.where(np.isfinite(r_area) & (r_area > 0), r_area, np.nan))
    i_sqrt = np.sqrt(np.where(np.isfinite(i_area) & (i_area > 0), i_area, np.nan))
    Lr = np.nanmedian(r_sqrt)
    Li = np.nanmedian(i_sqrt)
    if np.isfinite(Lr) and np.isfinite(Li):
        L = (float(Lr) + float(Li)) * 0.5
    elif np.isfinite(Lr):
        L = float(Lr)
    elif np.isfinite(Li):
        L = float(Li)
    else:
        L = 125.0
    if not np.isfinite(L) or L < 20.0 or L > 400.0:
        L = 125.0

    ffps = float(fps) if np.isfinite(float(fps)) else 10.0
    if ffps < 1.0:
        ffps = 10.0
    k = int(round(ffps * 0.5))
    if k < 3:
        k = 3
    if k > n and n >= 3:
        k = n
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    dist_thr = 1.2 * L
    gap_thr = 0.2 * L
    head_thr = 0.6 * L
    r_face_thr = 1.0
    i_face_thr = 2.0
    align_thr = 0.3
    vis_thr = 0.8
    vis_hi = 1.25
    deep_thr = 0.65
    elong_thr = 1.9
    i_still_thr = 1.5 * L
    r_still_thr = 3.0 * L

    i_nan = (~np.isfinite(i_cx)) | (~np.isfinite(i_area))
    i_nan = i_nan | (np.isfinite(i_present) & (i_present < 0.5))
    r_ok = np.isfinite(r_cx) & np.isfinite(i_cx if False else r_cx) & np.isfinite(r_area)
    r_ok = r_ok & ((~np.isfinite(r_present)) | (r_present > 0.5))

    idx = np.arange(n)
    fin_d = np.isfinite(dist)
    ff_d = np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(fin_d, idx, -1))
    dist_ff = np.full(n, np.nan)
    has_d = ff_d >= 0
    dist_ff[has_d] = dist[ff_d[has_d]]
    fin_g = np.isfinite(gap)
    ff_g = np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(fin_g, idx, -1))
    gap_ff = np.full(n, np.nan)
    has_g = ff_g >= 0
    gap_ff[has_g] = gap[ff_g[has_g]]

    dist_was_close = np.isfinite(dist_ff) & (dist_ff < dist_thr)
    gap_was_close = np.isfinite(gap_ff) & (gap_ff < gap_thr)
    i_nan_close = i_nan & (dist_was_close | gap_was_close)

    dist_fill = np.where(np.isfinite(dist_ff), dist_ff, 1e6)
    gap_fill = np.where(np.isfinite(gap_ff), gap_ff, 1e6)
    dist_s = smooth(dist_fill, k)
    gap_s = smooth(gap_fill, k)

    i_vis_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_vis), i_vis, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_vis_s = smooth(i_vis_f, k)
    r_ht_f = np.where(np.isfinite(r_ht), r_ht, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    r_ht_s = smooth(r_ht_f, k)
    i_ht_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_ht), i_ht, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_ht_s = smooth(i_ht_f, k)
    r_face_f = np.where(np.isfinite(r_face), r_face, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_face_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_face), i_face, np.where(i_nan_close, np.pi, np.nan))
    r_face_s = smooth(r_face_f, k)
    i_face_s = smooth(i_face_f, k)
    cos_raw = np.cos(r_h - i_h)
    cos_f = np.where(np.isfinite(cos_raw), cos_raw, np.where(i_nan_close, 1.0, np.nan))
    cos_s = smooth(cos_f, k)
    i_speed_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_speed), i_speed, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_speed_s = smooth(i_speed_f, k)
    r_speed_s = smooth(r_speed, k)
    r_elo_s = smooth(r_elo, k)
    i_elo_s = smooth(i_elo, k)

    prox = (dist_s < dist_thr) | (gap_s < gap_thr) | i_nan_close
    grasp = (np.isfinite(r_ht_s) & (r_ht_s < head_thr)) | (np.isfinite(i_ht_s) & (i_ht_s < head_thr))
    still = np.isfinite(i_speed_s) & np.isfinite(r_speed_s) & (i_speed_s < i_still_thr) & (r_speed_s < r_still_thr)
    rearR = np.isfinite(r_face_s) & (r_face_s < r_face_thr)
    rearI_align = (np.isfinite(i_face_s) & (i_face_s > i_face_thr)) | (np.isfinite(cos_s) & (cos_s > align_thr))
    occ = (np.isfinite(i_vis_s) & (i_vis_s < vis_thr)) | (np.isfinite(i_vis_s) & (i_vis_s > vis_hi))
    occ = occ | i_nan_close
    deep = (np.isfinite(i_vis_s) & (i_vis_s < deep_thr)) | i_nan_close

    both_fin = np.isfinite(r_elo_s) & np.isfinite(i_elo_s)
    elong_gate = (~both_fin) | ((r_elo_s > elong_thr) & (i_elo_s > elong_thr))

    sup = (rearR.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(rearR, 'astype') else rearR) + (rearI_align.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(rearI_align, 'astype') else rearI_align) + (occ.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(occ, 'astype') else occ)
    must = prox & grasp & still & r_ok & elong_gate
    raw = must & ((sup >= 2) | (deep & (sup >= 1)))
    raw = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool)

    cleaned = bouts_clean(raw, ffps, min_s=0.5, max_gap_s=0.3)
    out = np.asarray(cleaned, dtype=bool).ravel()
    if out.size != n:
        out = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool).ravel()
        if out.size != n:
            tmp = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
            m = out.size if out.size < n else n
            if m > 0:
                tmp[0:m] = out[0:m]
            out = tmp
    out = np.asarray(out, dtype=bool).reshape(n)
    return out
